messages:
amy: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can someone clarify APAC GPU availability and the autoscale per-customer limits? I didn't catch the exact numbers.

raj: Short answer: APAC (SIN) ramp is on track. We're provisioning in two waves: ~8 A100 hosts in late May (pre-prod) and ~24 more in June (prod), ~32 total to start. I'll post host IDs and the PO once they're confirmed.

maria: For Dedicated pools the default autoscale cap is 50 instances per-customer, with burst-to-80 allowed for reserved customers. For the hosted API the soft realtime slot limit is 10 per account; support can raise that for high-usage customers after review.

kevin: Quick clarification — when you say "slot" do you mean a full 1xA100 worker or a vGPU slice? We should avoid ambiguity in customer comms.

maria: Good call. Right now a slot ~= 1xA100-40GB worker (no fractional vGPU in public docs). We're tracking vGPU mappings for the next-quarter roadmap.

raj: TL;DR: APAC GA target end of June. SIN will be single-A100 initial scheduling, then mixed A100+H100 by Q3 for better cost/latency options.

olivia: Is the autoscaler reactive to queue length or to token throughput/latency? I remember there was a plan to use a blended signal.

maria: Correct — the autoscaler uses a blended signal (queued requests + 95th percentile latency + GPU util). It's configurable per pool. Example policy snippet: ```policy:
  scale_metric: blended
  max_instances: 50
  burst_instances: 80
  scale_up_threshold: 0.75
  scale_down_delay_sec: 300
```

infra-bot: Deploy notice — Started provisioning sin-region-capacity-5 at 1782896820. Provisioning 8 hosts (A100-40GB). Status: booting.

raj: We'll publish an Ops doc with the exact capacity numbers, host tags, and a short runbook for on-call to handle capacity alarms (SLA breach -> emergency scale policy). Expect that doc by EOD tomorrow.

amy: Thanks — will you post the doc link here when it's up? Also: will Dedicated customers get automatic cross-region failover or is that opt-in?

kevin: Not automatic for Dedicated. Cross-region failover is an opt-in feature (requires config & replication). Hosted customers get multi-region routing automatically based on latency policies and routing tiers. We'll add a diagram to the doc.

olivia: Any ETA on whether pricing will change once APAC capacity is live? Some customers asked if new regions bump rates.

raj: No pricing changes planned at launch. If unit economics improve we may pass savings along later, but that's a separate comms effort — we'll announce explicitly if anything changes.

amy: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: Also adding a quick note — if you're on on-call and see "capacity-pressure" alerts, the immediate steps are: 1) check pool utilization, 2) verify recent deploys, 3) trigger emergency-scale (if thresholds met) and ping raj/maria. I'll add the checklist to the Ops doc.

raj: I'll also schedule a 30-min follow-up sync next week (invite to infra channel) to walk through the runbook and answer customer questions.

amy: Perfect — I'll close this thread after the doc is posted. Thanks all.
